chapter_title: General Provisions Regarding Imports and Exports
title: Other Conditions for Import of Replacement Goods
text: 2.41 Other Conditions for Import of Replacement Goods (a) In case of short-shipment, short-landing or loss in transit, import of replacement goods will be permitted based on certificate issued by customs authorities without an import Authorisation. (b) This procedure shall also apply to cases in which short shipment of goods is certified by foreign supplier, who has agreed to replace free of cost. (c) Cases not covered by above provisions will be considered on merits by DGFT for grant of Authorisation for replacement of goods for which an application may be made as per paragraph 2.47 of HBP. pg. 24 2.41 Other Conditions for Import of Replacement Goods (a) In case of short-shipment, short-landing or loss in transit, import of replacement goods will be permitted based on certificate issued by customs authorities without an import Authorisation.
